The epigraph from Longfellow's Evangeline. It states nothing about the game; 'crowned' and 'king-row' in it are a poem's words, and becomes-king quotes the rule.
The lead-in to the rules on pp. 427-430, which states nothing of its own. Each rule under it is quoted by its own entry, from board-placement to forty-move-limit.
